title: Workflow Groups — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A set of chain choices for a group of employees, so that, for example, head-office staff use a different leave chain. An employee's group comes from their current organisation assignment; an employee with none uses the default group. Groups are used only when the workflow setting EnableWorkflowGroup is on.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Required. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: IsDefault
fields.html:
What it is. Whether this is the group for employees who have none.

Why it matters. Only one group can be the default.

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.
